submission.justification: Mixture-G1 at 2.0 mm gap provides the optimal configuration for the resistive-plate muon chamber upgrade, achieving 1.275 ns time resolution - the best performance among all environmentally compliant options. This recommendation is based on comprehensive simulation testing across 5 different gap values (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0 mm), which confirmed a clear performance minimum at 2.0 mm. Mixture-G1 outperforms the alternative compliant mixture (G2) by 0.76 ns across all gap configurations. While the eliminated Mixture-G3 (standard fluorinated) achieved better resolution (0.9 ns), it fails the mandatory GWP100 ≤ 150 environmental constraint with typical GWP values exceeding 10,000. The selected configuration represents the necessary performance trade-off (0.375 ns degradation) to meet strict environmental requirements while still delivering excellent time resolution. The 2.0 mm gap is robust, manufacturable, and compatible with the existing HV system and planned 90% gas recirculation infrastructure.
